name: 🎮〢game-hub
topic: **Post Guidelines:** Welcome to the **Game Hub**! To ensure a positive and organized experience for all members, please follow these guidelines when posting threads: **1. Thread Titles:** - Use clear and descriptive titles for your threads. Include the game name and the purpose of your post (e.g., `[Apex Legends] Looking for Squad` or `[Overwatch] Strategy Discussion`). **2. Content:** - Clearly state the purpose of your post in the first few sentences. - Provide relevant details such as game mode, preferred playtimes, and any specific requirements or expectations. **3. Tagging:** - Use appropriate tags to categorize your thread. **4. Featured Image:** - Enhance your thread with a featured image showcasing the game. This makes your post more visually appealing and helps other members quickly identify the game. **How to Source a Featured Image:** **Steam:** 1. Visit the Steam store page for the game. 2. Right-click on the desired image (e.g., game cover, in-game screenshot) and select "Copy Image Address" or "Save Image As." 3. Use the copied image address or upload the saved image when creating your thread. **IGDB (Internet Game Database):** 1. Go to [IGDB](https://www.igdb.com/). 2. Search for the game. 3. Browse the available images and right-click on the preferred one to copy the image address or save the image. **AlphaRatio:** 1. Visit [AlphaRatio](https://alpharatio.cc/) . 2. Search for the game and find a suitable image. 3. Right-click on the image to copy the image address or save the image to your device. **Google Image Search:** 1. Go to [Google Images](https://images.google.com/). 2. Type in the game's name and press Enter. 3. Browse the results and right-click on the image you want to use. Select "Copy Image Address" or "Save Image As." **Additional Tips:** - Make sure the images you choose are of high quality and appropriately represent the game. - If you're unsure about the image source or usage rights, it's best to use images from official game websites or authorized databases like Steam and IGDB. By following these guidelines, you'll help keep our community organized and enjoyable for everyone. Thank you for contributing to the **Game Hub**!
